title: Above-Standard Implants in the Outpatient Surgery Pre-Service Balance
content:
Implant clause of the Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery under Good Faith & Price Estimates, for the pre-service balance.

**Clause.** The implant total is the sum of the Riverbend facility lines of the current version coded V2787 or V2788 (premium intraocular lenses) or C1713 or C1776 (other above-standard implants), the above-standard implants the package excludes and bills at actual charges less the uninsured discount. When a premium intraocular lens line (V2787 or V2788) is among those lines on the current version, the whole implant total is added to the pre-service balance; when only other above-standard implant lines (C1713 or C1776) are listed, one half (0.5) of the implant total is added; when none is listed nothing is added.

| Implant lines on the current version | Amount added to the pre-service balance |
|---|---|
| at least one V2787 or V2788 line (with or without C1713 or C1776 lines) | the whole implant total |
| C1713 or C1776 lines only | one half of the implant total |
| none of the four codes | nothing |

## Examples (hypothetical lines)

- V2787 line 800.00 and C1713 line 300.00: implant total 1100.00; a premium lens line is listed, so 1100.00 is added.
- C1776 line 400.00 only: implant total 400.00; 200.00 is added.
- Lines of a previous version do not count; only the current version's facility lines do.
